model_annotation: The plot illustrates the values of three different policy areas over time. The x-axis is labeled "Index" and spans from 2016 to 2024, with a linear scale and tick labels every two years. The y-axis on the left side is labeled "Wirtschaftspolitik insgesamt (linke Skala)" and "Finanzpolitik (linke Skala)" and ranges from 0 to 1000, with tick labels at intervals of 100. The y-axis on the right side is labeled "Handelspolitik (rechte Skala)" and ranges from 0 to 9.000, with tick labels at intervals of 1.000. A black solid line, representing "Wirtschaftspolitik insgesamt," starts at a value of approximately 150 in 2016, increases to a peak of approximately 570 around 2020, and then declines to approximately 200 in 2024. A gray solid line, representing "Finanzpolitik," begins at approximately 150 in 2016, fluctuates between approximately 150 and 250 until 2020, and then increases to approximately 3.000 in 2024. A blue solid line, representing "Handelspolitik," starts at approximately 1.000 in 2016, fluctuates between approximately 1.000 and 2.000 until 2020, and then increases to approximately 8.800 in 2024.
